title: Machine learning-based fast charging of lithium-ion battery by perceiving and regulating internal microscopic states
evidence_area: Proposes an ML-based fast charging strategy with multi-physical awareness in a battery-to-cloud framework, regulating internal microscopic states.
evidence_method: Soft actor-critic (SAC) deep reinforcement learning algorithm exploited to train a fast charging strategy.
evidence_valid: Hardware-in-Loop tests and experiments with practical LIBs are carried out for validation.
comment: No train/test protocol reported; validation is hardware/HIL only. ROM runs as the RL environment (not in the loss) - RL coded as headline family; alt reading Hybrid physics+ML. Chemistry unspecified in abstract.

title: Remaining useful life prediction of lithium battery based on deep reinforcement learning fusion network
evidence_area: RUL prediction of lithium batteries; single models struggle with spatio-temporal correlations and fusing multi-model contributions.
evidence_method: Integrates LSTM and Transformer for preliminary RUL predictions; results fused and optimized using a Deep Q-Network (DQN).
evidence_valid: Experiments utilize the lithium battery dataset from the MIT-Stanford-Toyota Research Center (Severson dataset).
comment: Train/test split not stated in accessible abstract; no strong protocol credited (weak fallback). DQN fuses base predictors - alt family reading Deep learning.

title: Identifying degradation patterns of lithium ion batteries from impedance spectroscopy using machine learning
evidence_area: Estimates capacity and predicts RUL from EIS spectra as key indicators of battery state of health.
evidence_method: Battery forecasting system combining EIS with Gaussian process machine learning; takes the entire spectrum as input, no further feature engineering.
evidence_valid: We train the EIS-Capacity GPR model on four cells cycled at 25 C (25C01-25C04), and test it on the other four cells (25C05-25C08).
comment: Commercial LCO/graphite coin cells, 20000+ spectra. RUL prediction also headline; area SOH vs Prognostics (RUL) ambiguity flagged.

title: A Comprehensive Review of Multiple Physical and Data-Driven Model Fusion Methods for Accurate Lithium-Ion Battery Inner State Factor Estimation
evidence_area: Reviews fusion of physics-based and data-driven models for SOC, SOH and state-of-power estimation in battery management.
evidence_method: Reviews the fusion application between physics-based and data-driven models; multi-model fusion approaches emerged as a research hotspot.
evidence_valid: No primary validation; evaluates fusion models effectiveness in improving state estimation accuracy and robustness.
comment: Cross-function review (SOC/SOH/SOP): coded to dominant technique family per review-handling rule, flagged review-type; alt reading Review / perspective.

title: Data-Driven Fast Charging Optimization for Lithium-Ion Battery Using Bayesian Optimization With Fast Convergence
evidence_area: Data-driven fast-charging optimization to find minimum charging time without damaging the batteries.
evidence_method: Hybrid Bayesian optimization algorithm combining mesh grid adaptive search; model-free, treats fast-charging control as a black-box optimization problem.
evidence_valid: Different search strategies and acquisition functions are evaluated on multiple constant charge protocols (test setting not detailed).
comment: Data source/test setup not explicit in abstract; assumed in-house battery tests; no split protocol. BO carries headline.

title: Untangling Degradation Chemistries of Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries Through Interpretable Hybrid Machine Learning
evidence_area: Interpretable hybrid ML framework untangling degradation chemistries of conversion-type batteries; end-of-life prediction with test MAE 8.9%.
evidence_method: Interpretable hybrid machine learning framework; not a black box; generates physical understandings and discovers a new performance indicator.
evidence_valid: Test mean absolute error of 8.9 % for the end-of-life prediction.
comment: Split protocol and data source not specified in accessible abstract; no strong protocol credited. Framework self-described hybrid; module composition unclear - coded shallow (tabular, interpretable); alt readings Hybrid/Deep. Flagged for dispute.

title: Interpretable machine learning for battery capacities prediction and coating parameters analysis
evidence_area: Predicts battery product properties (cell, gravimetric, volumetric capacity) and explains coating parameter effects at the early-manufacturing stage.
evidence_method: Interpretable machine learning framework predicting battery product properties and explaining interactions of manufacturing parameters.
evidence_valid: Three types of battery capacities predicted with R2 over 0.98 at the battery early-manufacturing stage (no split protocol reported).
comment: Manufacturing-stage capacity prediction; area closest bucket SOH (alt Cross-cutting). Dataset from a real manufacturing chain (coded self-lab). Split unstated.

title: Physical informed neural network for SOH estimation of lithium-ion battery with electrochemical mechanism
evidence_area: EM-PINN for SOH estimation based on the electrochemical degradation mechanism of SEI layer growth.
evidence_method: PINN embeds physical laws into the loss: PDE, boundary condition, initial condition and SOH physical loss jointly guide learning.
evidence_valid: Experimental validation on three public datasets (XJTU, MIT, and HUST); six testing scenarios with different data volumes.
comment: Section 4 split details not accessible; no strong protocol credited. Chemistry unspecified in accessible text. Datasets span three sources (mixed).

title: Deep learning-driven detection of lithium-plating-type defects for battery manufacturing via formation and capacity grading data
evidence_area: In-line detection of lithium-plating-type defects during battery manufacturing to prevent defective, safety-critical batteries entering the market.
evidence_method: Dual-task deep learning model: reconstruction learns latent representations, classification identifies defective batteries; Shapley value analysis for interpretability.
evidence_valid: Validated on statistically robust samples: recall 97.14 % for defective batteries and overall accuracy of 97.42 % (split unstated).
comment: Dataset: formation/capacity-grading data from 154 batteries (48 defective/106 normal), manufacturing chain - coded self-lab. Split protocol unstated. Detection = QC on safety-critical defects; area alt Cross-cutting.

title: The development of machine learning-based remaining useful life prediction for lithium-ion batteries
evidence_area: Reviews the development of ML-based RUL prediction for lithium-ion batteries over the past decade.
evidence_method: Ten most used ML algorithms identified in 380 relevant papers; comparison of accuracy and characteristics.
evidence_valid: No primary validation; literature synthesis with outlook on improvement directions.
comment: Single-function (RUL) review: keeps function with Review / perspective per codebook.

title: Temperature prediction of lithium-ion battery based on artificial neural network model
evidence_area: Estimates temperature change of lithium-ion batteries in a metal foam thermal management system.
evidence_method: BP-NN, RBF-NN and Elman-NN establish temperature prediction models; Elman-NN shows better adaptability and generalization.
evidence_valid: Performance tests under the sample condition and the new condition were carried out respectively.
comment: Coded cross-domain because generalization is tested on a 'new condition'; if that condition was not outside training settings, gold may hold experimental hardware - flagged. Chemistry unspecified. Shallow nets on engineered features.

title: Rethinking lithium-ion battery management: Eliminating routine cell balancing enhances hazardous fault detection
evidence_area: Eliminating routine cell balancing; found no loss of balance and enhanced early detection of low-level self-discharge from developing internal short circuits.
evidence_method: Charging algorithm designed to maximise energy throughput while accommodating varying capacity, impedance and aging characteristics of individual cells (no ML model).
evidence_valid: Extensive cycle testing on a range of different battery configurations (physical cycling; isolation unspecified).
comment: No ML anywhere (verified by full-text search). Method family is a judgment call - closest bucket chosen; flagged for dispute. Area: balancing vs Fault & safety ambiguity (detection claim in title). Chemistries: LFP (HEADWAY, CALB), LCO (GP1865L220), Panasonic/Samsung, Nissan modules - mixed.

title: Explainability-driven model improvement for SOH estimation of lithium-ion battery
evidence_area: Explainability-driven model improvement framework for SOH estimation; explanations fed back to guide model training.
evidence_method: Post-hoc explanation technique explains the model; insights are fed back to guide training; validated on different datasets and different models.
evidence_valid: Validated on different datasets and different models; released code uses a battery-wise train/test split (test cell held out).
comment: Abstract + open-source code (wang-fujin/Explainability-driven_SOH) inspected; paper methods section not accessible. Datasets BIT/CALCE/MIT (mixed; CALCE LCO + MIT LFP -> mixed chem). CNN/LSTM/Transformer backbones.

title: Machine Learning in Lithium‐Ion Battery Cell Production: A Comprehensive Mapping Study
evidence_area: Systematic mapping study of machine learning applications in lithium-ion battery cell production.
evidence_method: Details state-of-the-art applications of ML in battery cell production, covering product/process parameters and adopted algorithms.
evidence_valid: No primary validation; compiled findings from multi-perspective comparisons.
comment: Review spanning the production domain (no BMS function) -> Cross-cutting with Review / perspective; review-handling alt: dominant technique family. Full text not retrievable (Cloudflare); abstract-only.

title: Optimized charging of lithium-ion battery for electric vehicles: Adaptive multistage constant current–constant voltage charging strategy
evidence_area: Adaptive multistage constant current-constant voltage charging strategy for electric vehicles with Pareto-optimal trade-off.
evidence_method: Charging current optimized using particle swarm optimization on a coupled thermoelectric-aging model within RC electrical, thermal network and aging models.
evidence_valid: Results show balanced charging strategy 3.60 % better aging loss vs 0.5C CCCV and 37 % charging time reduction (simulation-based).
comment: Model-based simulation study; no experiments reported in accessible text. PSO-optimized control -> Optimization-augmented control. Chemistry unspecified.

title: Energy-Efficient Battery Thermal Management in Electric Vehicles Using Artificial-Neural-Network-Based Model Predictive Control
evidence_area: MPC strategy for EV battery thermal management optimizing energy efficiency while keeping battery temperature within the optimal range.
evidence_method: ANN-based model of a MATLAB/Simscape high-fidelity model; infinity-horizon MPC with a value function; ANN-assisted MPC.
evidence_valid: Proposed controller evaluated using a simulation environment against a conventional rule-based controller under varying ambient temperatures.
comment: Simulation-only study; surrogate co-design -> Optimization-augmented control (alt Hybrid physics+ML). Chemistry unspecified.

title: Deep learning to estimate lithium-ion battery state of health without additional degradation experiments
evidence_area: Estimates SOH without target battery labels; domain adaptation framework for cross-dataset estimation.
evidence_method: Framework integrates a swarm of deep neural networks equipped with domain adaptation.
evidence_valid: Two self-developed and three public battery degradation datasets for cross-validation (80 cases, 65 cells, five manufacturers; no target labels).
comment: Target domain has no labels -> cross-domain credited. Paper's word 'cross-validation' = cross-dataset evaluation. Five cathode chemistries (LCO, LCO/NCO, ...) -> mixed.

title: Battery SOC estimation from EIS data based on machine learning and equivalent circuit model
evidence_area: Estimates SOC from EIS measurements; discriminates between different SOC values and produces a low-dimensional classification model.
evidence_method: SOC estimation approach based on EIS and an equivalent circuit model; ECM+ML per codebook border example.
evidence_valid: Experimentally validated on a dataset of EIS measurements on four lithium-ion cylindrical cells at different SOC values; above 93 % accuracy (split unstated).
comment: Codebook: ECM+ML SOC from EIS -> Hybrid physics+ML. Split protocol not stated; weak fallback. Four cylindrical cells, EIS dataset.

title: Machine Learning-Based Data-Driven Fault Detection/Diagnosis of Lithium-Ion Battery: A Critical Review
evidence_area: Comprehensive review exclusively on state-of-the-art ML-based data-driven fault detection/diagnosis techniques for LIB systems.
evidence_method: Reviews ML-based techniques over conventional model-based, knowledge-based and signal processing-based fault diagnosis methods.
evidence_valid: No primary validation; synthesis with current issues and future challenges.
comment: Single-function (fault) review: keeps function with Review / perspective.

title: Novel state of charge estimation method of containerized Lithium–Ion battery energy storage system based on deep learning
evidence_area: SOC estimation for containerized lithium-ion battery energy storage systems; model-driven estimation challenging due to coupled internal processes.
evidence_method: Deep learning SOC estimation based on attention mechanism and CNN-LSTM network; CNN layers extract critical features of the battery dataset.
evidence_valid: Not reported in accessible abstract text.
comment: Only abstract text retrievable (fragments); data source and split protocol not stated - flagged; no strong protocol credited. Deep (attention+CNN-LSTM) model.

title: Estimation of lithium-ion battery electrochemical properties from equivalent circuit model parameters using machine learning
evidence_area: Neural network estimates critical electrochemical parameters of a P2D model from online ECM parameters to improve battery state estimation (digital twin).
evidence_method: Neural network correlates ECM parameters to critical electrochemical parameters of a Pseudo-Two-Dimensional PBM; ECM and PBM used synergistically.
evidence_valid: Trained and validated on a synthetic dataset generated using a Pseudo-Two-Dimensional PBM exploring various degrees of battery degradation.
comment: Degradation-parameter tracking; area alt Cross-cutting/ECM - flagged. Physics supplies synthetic training data (adjacent, not in loss) -> Hybrid physics+ML. Chemistry unspecified.

title: Lithium-ion battery remaining useful life prediction based on interpretable deep learning and network parameter optimization
evidence_area: RUL prediction combined with interpretable deep learning and network parameter optimization; identifies important aging features and prunes useless data.
evidence_method: Fused deep learning model (CNN+LSTM); interpretable algorithm quantifies feature contributions; network parameter optimization.
evidence_valid: Four batteries constitute the training set, and the residual one battery is used as the testing set in every batch (12 result groups).
comment: Dataset = Stanford-MIT (Severson) LFP/A123 cells. Cross-cell split per batch (train 4, test 1).

title: Battery health features extraction and state of health estimation based on real-time online vehicle driving data
evidence_area: Extracts battery health features and estimates SOH from real-time online vehicle driving data under BMS computational limitations.
evidence_method: Bayesian Optimization-XGBoost-Attention Mechanism (BO-XGBoost-AM) compared with XGBoost, PSO-LSTM, GRU, ETR and GPR.
evidence_valid: Dataset spanning 7 months utilized to validate; day-based division strategy optimal with 3-day interval (MAE/RMSE/MAPE below 3.2 %).
comment: Online/deployed status not evidenced -> strong 'online/real-vehicle' protocol not credited; split unstated (weak fallback). BO tunes hyperparameters; headline estimator XGBoost ensemble -> Shallow ML (alt Bayesian optimization).

title: Transfer Learning-Based Lithium-Ion Battery State of Health Estimation With Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy
evidence_area: Transfer learning-based SOH estimation using explainable EIS; physical parameters fitted by an equivalent circuit model as aging features.
evidence_method: Spatiotemporal LSTM extracts time-series features; transfer learning strategy fine-tunes initial model parameters.
evidence_valid: Fine-tuning the initial model parameters on different temperatures and different types of cells to estimate the SOH of the target cell.
comment: Two public EIS datasets; cell types/chemistries unspecified. Cross-domain (temperature/cell-type shift) strongest reported.

title: A multi-fault diagnosis method for lithium-ion battery pack using curvilinear Manhattan distance evaluation and voltage difference analysis
evidence_area: Rapid multi-fault diagnosis for lithium-ion battery packs: detect, locate and determine fault types for sudden and progressive faults.
evidence_method: Curvilinear Manhattan distance quantization of charging voltage curves plus voltage difference analysis; no learning model (classical data-driven method).
evidence_valid: Diagnosis experiments implemented based on the aging data of the series-connected lithium-ion battery pack (isolation unspecified).
comment: No ML model - method is a judgment call, flagged for dispute. Data = pack aging tests (self-lab).

title: Performance analysis on liquid-cooled battery thermal management for electric vehicles based on machine learning
evidence_area: Performance analysis of liquid-cooled battery thermal management for EVs based on machine learning; predicts cooling capacity and system COP.
evidence_method: PSO-optimized SVR with RBF kernel trained on experimental data.
evidence_valid: Datasets randomly separated into training and test datasets: 80 % training, 20 % test.
comment: Random 80/20 split of experimental dataset (weak protocol). PSO tunes hyperparameters; SVR carries headline -> Shallow ML.

title: Machine learning pipeline for battery state-of-health estimation
evidence_area: Comprehensive machine learning pipeline (BHUMP) for battery SOH estimation across chemistries and form factors.
evidence_method: GPR, RF, BRR and deep NN on 30 engineered features; random forest recursive feature elimination with cross-validation.
evidence_valid: Cells grouped by charging protocol: CC-CV Group I (47), CC Group II (124), 2-step Group III (8); separate model training and performance assessment per group.
comment: Accepted-manuscript (preprint) read. Cells include A123 LFP and LCO (mixed). Train/test partitions in Supplementary Note 5 (not accessible); per-cell batch cross-validation + per-group holdout -> cross-cell credited.

title: Towards a smarter battery management system: A critical review on deep learning-based state of charge estimation of lithium-ion batteries
evidence_area: Structured review on deep learning-based SOC estimation; taxonomy of approaches and commonly used public datasets.
evidence_method: Systematic walk-through of deep learning SOC approaches and optimization strategies; appeals for a standardized evaluation protocol.
evidence_valid: No primary validation; discusses trends including PINNs, multi-task, few-shot and continual learning.
comment: Single-function (SOC) review: keeps function with Review / perspective.

title: Early prediction of battery lifetime via a machine learning based framework
evidence_area: Machine learning framework for early prediction of battery lifetime using only the first-100-cycle degradation data.
evidence_method: 42 handcrafted features, four feature selection methods, six representative ML models; SVM with wrapper selection best (RMSE 115 cycles, R2 0.90).
evidence_valid: A stratified random sampling method is used to split the dataset, and this is repeated 20 times to reduce the randomness of experimental results.
comment: MIT dataset = 124 LFP/graphite A123 cells (Severson-MATR). Repeated stratified random cell-level split -> cross-cell credited. Evidence from archived page (abstract + data description + methods excerpt).

title: Lithium-Ion Battery Pack Robust State of Charge Estimation, Cell Inconsistency, and Balancing: Review
evidence_area: State of the art of battery pack SOC estimation methods with the impact of cell inconsistency; balancing discussed as consequence.
evidence_method: Four categories of pack SOC estimation methods compared by algorithm type, computational load and engineering effort; no primary validation.
evidence_valid: Review synthesis; no primary validation reported.
comment: Dominant function SOC estimation (balancing secondary) -> State estimation (SOC); alt Cross-cutting. Full text read.
